d: Long, flowing olive-blonde hair with loose waves and a thick braid falls over one shoulder, topped with a red headscarf adorned with small white flowers. The eyes are a pale ice-blue with a calm, soft expression on a youthful face. A slender build is dressed in a white blouse under a brown cropped jacket, layered with a long tan apron-dress, a red patterned shawl, and a decorative red and gold tiered skirt with blue fringed hems. Signature accessories include a red headscarf, black gloves, and a large leather art satchel filled with paintbrushes and rolled canvases.
